# Ctrip travel services

A travel services application for account access, flight search and booking, order management, reusable traveler information, flight status, vouchers, and airport guidance.

Dates, voucher eligibility and public countdowns use Asia/Shanghai and the shared application/evaluator clock 2026-07-19T08:00:00+08:00.

Sessions, current search criteria, booking selections and status-search history are established by public UI behavior within each scenario, never injected into storage.

## REQ-1 Account access

Visitors can enter password or verification-code login and register through agreement, phone verification and password setup. Legal acceptance is required. Logout removes the session.

Global navigation is a single navigation landmark named Global navigation. Fields have associated labels. Actions described only as controls may be buttons or links; explicit tabs, radios, checkboxes, dialogs and fields retain their declared semantics. Verification delivery is simulated and codes are valid only after being sent in the current attempt. Password strength is a named region.

For simulated verification delivery: Code becomes valid after Send code. Source 13800000044..47 are example new phones, replaced by deterministic isolated phones; never pre-create their accounts.

For phone accounts: Created by registration UI, isolated deterministic phone per test.

**Type:** FOLDER
**Dependencies:** None

With a sent code 123456 and "Agree to terms"(role=checkbox) selected, "Log in"(role=button) authenticates and displays "My account"(role=button). Missing mobile or code, an incorrect code, or absent agreement shows the declared alert and retains the signed-out form; required fields cannot substitute for each other.

Verification delivery is simulated. A verification code is valid only after being sent in the current attempt.

### REQ-1.6 Verify a new mobile for registration

After "Register"(role=link) opens "Registration agreement and privacy policy"(role=dialog), "Agree and continue"(role=button) advances to Verify mobile number. Users enter an unused isolated phone in "Mobile number"(role=textbox) and click "Send code"(role=button), enabling accepted code 123456 and changing the action to "Resend code"(role=button). Entering that code in "Verification code"(role=textbox) and clicking "Next, set password"(role=button) opens Set password with "Password"(role=textbox) and "Confirm password"(role=textbox).

Verification delivery is simulated. A verification code is valid only after being sent in the current attempt.

description:
  text: |-

    Dates, voucher eligibility and public countdowns use Asia/Shanghai and the shared application/evaluator clock 2026-07-19T08:00:00+08:00.

    Sessions, current search criteria, booking selections and status-search history are established by public UI behavior within each scenario, never injected into storage.
scenarios: []

Actions described only as controls may be buttons or links; explicit tabs, radios, checkboxes, dialogs and fields retain their declared semantics. Verification delivery is simulated and codes are valid only after being sent in the current attempt. Password strength is a named region.

      For phone accounts: Created by registration UI, isolated deterministic phone per test.

        Under "Flights"(role=button) and "More services"(role=button), "Domestic airport directory"(role=button) opens Airport guide with "Domestic airports"(role=tab) selected and "Domestic airports"(role=region) visible. "International airport directory"(role=button) selects "International and Hong Kong, Macau, Taiwan airports"(role=tab) and displays the matching "International and Hong Kong, Macau, Taiwan airports"(role=region).

        Global navigation is a navigation landmark named Global navigation. Fields have associated labels; explicitly named tabs, radios, checkboxes, dialogs and fields retain their stated roles.

        Airport weather is the stated snapshot, independent of the July business clock, not a live meteorological lookup. Service entries are uniquely named Record <airport-service name> within their list region.
      image:
      - id: IMG-MORESERVICE
        reference: reference/moreservice.png
        page: home
      - id: IMG-AIRPORT1
        reference: reference/airport1.png
        page: airport_guide
    scenarios:
    - id: SCN-REQ-9.4-01
      name: Open domestic airport directory
      steps:
      - id: STEP-REQ-9.4-01-01
        Given: The visitor is signed out on the homepage; the benchmark clock is 2026-07-19 08:00 Asia/Shanghai.
        When: Activate Flights, More services and Domestic airport directory.
        Then: Airport guide opens with Domestic airports selected and its Chengdu link visible.
        references:
        - \ref[requirement](REQ-9.1)
        - \ref[image](IMG-MORESERVICE)
        - \ref[image](IMG-AIRPORT1)
    - id: SCN-REQ-9.4-02
      name: Open international airport directory
      steps:
      - id: STEP-REQ-9.4-02-01
        Given: The visitor is signed out on the homepage; the benchmark clock is 2026-07-19 08:00 Asia/Shanghai.
        When: Activate Flights, More services and International airport directory.
        Then: Airport guide opens with International and Hong Kong, Macau, Taiwan airports selected and Hong Kong
          International Airport visible in its matching region.
        references:
        - \ref[requirement](REQ-9.1)
        - \ref[image](IMG-MORESERVICE)
        - \ref[image](IMG-AIRPORT1)
    children: []
